@DIR@/Mod
-- want --
exit 0
-- stderr --
-- Mod/src/com/x/A.java --
class A {
  public static final Property xHours = newProperty(Flags.SUMMARY | Flags.READONLY, 0d, null);
  public void changed(Property p, Context cx) { execute(); }
  void execute() {
    if (Clock.millis() - lastCheckpoint < 60000) return;
    setXHours(1.0);
  }
}
